entities.summary: Fanny Risberg (b. 1975-05-05, Malmö Sankt Pauli parish) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Malmö Sankt Pauli parish and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
